acceptance_criteria.statement: Promoted listing purchase creates at most one active 7-day boost per task, verifies QPay payment, and surfaces the visual 'Онцлох' label in feed results.
Urgent boost purchase creates a 3-day higher-priority boost that sorts above promoted tasks and is eligible for urgent push-notification treatment.
Both visibility products are gated behind `promoted_listings_enabled`, prevent duplicate overlapping activations, and expire automatically at the configured end time.
